brief.zh: 标出主干，把所有修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding every modifier away.

t.zh: 论文里描述数据集的一句：主语和宾语各带一个从句，从句里又有介词短语。
t.en: A line describing a dataset: the subject and the object each carry a clause, and the clauses carry prepositional phrases.

hint.zh: from public sources 和 in 2023 说明的都是从句里的哪个动作？
hint.en: Which action inside a clause do from public sources and in 2023 tell about?

sentence: The dataset that we release with this paper contains images that were collected from public sources in 2023.

folds.span: that we release with this paper

sources.zh: “2023 年里的公开来源”说不通：2023 年说的是收集的时间。
sources.en: “Public sources in 2023” is not the point: 2023 is when the images were collected.

folds.span: that were collected from public sources in 2023

title.zh: The dataset that we release with this paper contains images that were collected from public sources in 2023.
title.en: The dataset that we release with this paper contains images that were collected from public sources in 2023.

body.zh: 主干只有 The dataset contains images。我们随本文发布的数据集，收录了 2023 年从公开来源收集的图像。
body.en: The skeleton is just The dataset contains images. The dataset we release with this paper holds images gathered from public sources in 2023.

note.zh: 每个从句都有自己的小主干；折起来，大句的主干就清楚了。
note.en: Every clause has a little skeleton of its own; fold them, and the sentence’s shows.
